rubrics.justification: Generally captures a usable blastocyst with weaker TE and no gross degeneration, but it overstates confidence about visible ICM location and comments on hatching/herniation and zona features that are not clearly demonstrated in this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age-related aneuploidy risk, AMH/ovarian reserve, prior ectopic, endometrium, sperm parameters, BMI, and cohort size with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with a plausible prognosis range tied to morphology and age; minor tension exists between calling it 4AB-compatible yet questioning visible hatching on the image.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, early ectopic surveillance, uterine/tubal review, and selective discussion of PGT-A. Minor deviations include some speculative emphasis on freeze-all and nonstandard mention of trophoblast/inhibin factors.

Provides clear next steps for transfer monitoring and future planning, including serial beta-hCG, early ultrasound, cavity/tubal assessment, and discussion of PGT-A, though some suggestions remain somewhat general.
